key_features: Complete Cabinet Protection: Protect your kitchen and bathroom cabinets from stains, drips, scratches, and everyday messes. The SIKADEER under sink mat helps keep shelves and floors clean, dry, and easy to maintain for a tidy storage space.

Superior Leak & Spill Defense: Designed with raised edges, the spacious tray design helps contain large amounts of liquid, giving you more time to handle unexpected plumbing issues. The flexible edge allows quick drainage by simply pressing the edge—no need to lift or carry a heavy mat during cleanup.

Premium Food-Grade Silicone: Made from high-quality BPA-free silicone, this odor-free liner is waterproof, heat-resistant, oil-resistant, and built for daily use. The smooth surface wipes clean easily and is dishwasher safe for convenient care.

16 Sizes for a Custom-Like Fit: Choose from 16 sizes to fit most kitchen and bathroom cabinets. Simply measure before ordering. The flexible silicone liner can be trimmed around pipes or corners, and when between sizes, choose the slightly smaller option.

Thoughtful Design: The dual-sided textured surface provides extra grip to keep bottles, supplies, and everyday items stable and organized. This silicone mat also works as a home organizer and storage solution, serving as a shelf and drawer liner, coffee mat, dish drying mat, pet feeding mat, boot tray, or countertop protector.
